test.template: Run `make test` and report any failures with their root causes.

format.template: Run `make format` and report any issues found at each stage.

spec-check.template: Run `make spec-check` and report any findings, with a suggested fix for each.

check.description: Run the full CI gate (lint, typecheck, tests, spec-check)
check.template: Run `make check` and report any failures at any stage.

spec-author.description: Writes feature specs from user intent into specs/drafts/ following specs/TEMPLATE.md, assigns the next SDD-NNNN. Use when: starting a new feature, documenting a non-trivial change, creating a formal spec before implementation.

spec-reviewer.description: Reviews spec drafts against specs/TEMPLATE.md: front-matter, EARS requirements, testable ACs tied to requirements, non-goals, file-change plan, test plan, conflict detection. Use when: validating a spec before approval.

feature-implementer.description: Implements an approved spec (status: approved) from specs/active/ test-first, runs the quality gates, prints an AC-coverage report. Use when: implementing a spec'd feature, multi-file changes driven by a spec.
